Package io.telekom.orchest.adapter.mongo.repository

Interface MongoTimedEventRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<TimedEvent,String>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<TimedEvent,String>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<TimedEvent,String>, org.springframework.data.mongodb.repository.MongoRepository<TimedEvent,String>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<TimedEvent,String>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<TimedEvent>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<TimedEvent,String>
@Repository public interface MongoTimedEventRepository extends org.springframework.data.mongodb.repository.MongoRepository<TimedEvent,String>
Spring Data MongoDB repository for TimedEvent documents. Stores detailed information about registered timer events.

    • listByProcessDefinitionIdAndIsStartEvent

      @Query("{ \'processDefinitionId\': ?0, \'isStartEvent\': ?1 }") List<TimedEvent> listByProcessDefinitionIdAndIsStartEvent(String processDefinitionId, boolean isStartEvent)
      Returns all rows that match processDefinitionId and isStartEvent so the adapter can cancel the corresponding scheduler tasks before the rows are removed. The @Query annotation disambiguates this from the singleton findBy... method above (Spring Data otherwise picks one or the other based on return type).
